changelog:
Initial release of Bookmark Intelligence.

- Automatically monitors your X (Twitter) bookmarks and fetches full content from linked articles.
- Uses AI to analyze and surface insights relevant to your active projects.
- Three subscription tiers: Free, Pro ($9/month), and Enterprise ($29/month) with varying features including team support, API access, and multiple notification options.
- Includes setup wizard for quick configuration, cookie retrieval guides for major browsers, and detailed usage instructions.
- Supports notifications via Telegram and integrates with Slack, Discord, and webhooks (Enterprise).
- Stores extracted insights in a searchable local knowledge base.
summary: Automatically monitors your X bookmarks, fetches linked articles, analyzes content with AI, and delivers insights relevant to your projects via notifications.
